checks: Display and city profiles agree on probe scheduling; balanced allocates no local cube or sunlight map
Dedicated sunlight capture uses 512/768 physical pixels at DPR 1.35/1.5, with exactly one depth submission per call
The local map follows the baked sun and contains all eight cube-volume corners plus 240 m of sunward blocker margin
Opaque mass remains eligible beyond the main-view shadow-distance gate; transparent, cutout, decal and hidden geometry do not become false opaque blockers
Render target, viewport, scissor, clear state, override, background, XR, shadow flags and visibility recover after success and injected failure
Returning to balanced releases the local sunlight target and disables its shader branch
scope: Deterministic resource, camera projection, HiDPI viewport and renderer-state regression tests with a stateful renderer double. No browser, graphics driver or rendered image is exercised.
limits: Shadow rasterization, packed-depth GPU filtering and visual quality require actual browser/GPU acceptance.
